d:
Dedicated to the remover of obstacles and the lord of wisdom, Lord Ganesha, presenting the powerful devotional song “Gajanana” from Bajirao Mastani. Sung by Sukhwinder Singh with soul-stirring music by Shreyas Puranik, this sacred chant fuels the spirit of Peshwa Bajirao and celebrates divine strength and devotion.
Credits
Song: Gajanana
Singer: Sukhwinder Singh
Music: Shreyas Puranik
Lyrics: Prashant Ingole
Arranged by: Jackie Vanjari
Film: Bajirao Mastani
